scope: development only; no held-out or platform parity pass
reviewer: single implementing assistant, unblinded, with prior score familiarity
method: Every Acorde PDF page rasterized by Poppler at 1800-pixel long edge and visually inspected; same 210 x 297 mm physical page, 1.8 mm staff space. Dense passages examined on full-page images. No independent human assessment or preference statistic.
source_boundary: Pitch/voice/onset/duration audit against shared MusicXML plus visual/source investigations. Five OMR MSCZ files and Freilachs use Acorde conversion for shared input; this does not establish MSCZ import fidelity.
